trust.verdict1Round: One round, and winning means there is no next time—“Always Exile” eats the whole city. Nobody has a reason to go easy.
trust.verdictHighNoise: Too much suspicion: nobody can tell whether the other side meant it or the order got garbled. Kindness can't hold on, and “Always Exile” takes over again.
trust.verdictMidNoise: By now the city is a mess: the ones who spare and the ones who hold grudges can't finish each other off. This is the ugliest stretch.
trust.verdictLowNoise: When there is a little misunderstanding around, the ones who give two chances live best—one garbled order doesn't wreck everything.
trust.verdictNoNoise: As long as you have to meet again, “Tit for Tat” holds down “Always Exile”: be kind first, bite back only after you're bitten.
